name: Add Comment
description: Add an unanchored comment to a Google Doc (general feedback, no text highlighting). [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/comments/create)

configurable_props.name: drive
configurable_props.label: Drive
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `My Drive`. To select a [Shared Drive](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351) instead, select it from this list.

configurable_props.name: fileId
configurable_props.label: File
configurable_props.description: The file to add a comment to.

configurable_props.name: content
configurable_props.label: Comment Content
configurable_props.description: The text content of the comment to add

configurable_props.name: anchor
configurable_props.label: Anchor
configurable_props.description: A region of the document represented as a JSON string. For details on defining anchor properties, refer to [Manage comments and replies](https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/v3/manage-comments).
